note: 'When assessing' is a condition of this sentence. It is not a 'where' clause, so applicability is omitted. The sentence names no duty-holder. The factors are cumulative. 'Those measures' refers to the measures in this paragraph. Discovery hints name plausible artifacts. They are not proof that a measure is appropriate, proportionate, or in place, and they are not proof that a Member State has transposed this duty.

references.law_text:
When assessing the proportionality of those measures, due account shall be
taken of the degree of the entity’s exposure to risks, the entity’s size and
the likelihood of occurrence of incidents and their severity, including their
societal and economic impact.
